response: derived measured path_loss_db from dataset PL appendix
predictor: log10 of 3D Tx-Rx distance in meters
split_unit: entire environment; do not split points within a route

bootstrap.method: cluster bootstrap by training measurement group

holdout_bootstrap.method: resample whole holdout environment-height measurement groups; do not resample individual points

acceptance_rule: Only claim model improvement if candidate MAE improves over the exact Phase 14 baseline with a cluster-level 95% interval wholly below zero and the improvement exceeds documented measurement uncertainty. If source uncertainty is absent or too few independent holdout groups exist, report descriptive holdout results only.
failure_policy: do not fit if fewer than 3 distinct training groups, less than 1 decade of distance, or no finite path-loss labels
reason_not_applied: public 3.6 GHz non-urban channel-sounder data do not identify project target-device power, gain, sensitivity, urban obstruction, or receive threshold
